scope: Prepared for author submission as a bounded empirical Computers & Graphics paper; not an acceptance or deployment-quality prediction. Portal upload has not been performed.
scientific_basis: Strong controls and a specified matched-applied-budget primary distinguish strength from temporal placement
Native-UV Bake10 links view metrics to final assets and retains the reference self-bake gap
All ten Bake10 outcomes and separate GSO20 non-detection remain available; Figure 3 examples are selection-labelled
Cross-interface primaries are described as study-specific; GSO100 is not presented as an independent backbone
Independent assessment states novelty risk and evidence limits rather than relying on compilation
unclosed_scientific_limits: No new schedule-selection method or residual-dose causal mechanism
No architecture-matched, official-default, complete-system TCAS-only quality comparison
Small compatibility-selected GeoTex bake cohort and post-inspection GSO calibration
No representative PBR, seam, or physical-material validation
Historical checkpoint, unknown replacement UID, and FAC replay identities remain incomplete
delivery_basis: 13-page main, 71-page Supplement, five-page Response, and 20-page original-to-final marked manuscript
Both video files and matching stills exist in a new versioned local delivery directory and pass full decoding and identity checks
Figure 2 and Figure 3 actual page comparisons are retained
Current source and per-file SHA-256 manifests are generated
